concerns.text: FR-007 mandates sensitivity analysis (MDE) for power=0.80. Task T025 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and lacks the specific logic to 'report as limitation' if observed effect < MDE. This is a semantic weakening of the requirement, leaving the core hypothesis testing constraint unimplemented.

FR-005 requires multiple-comparison correction (Bonferroni/BH) when >1 test is run. Task T023 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and does not include the conditional logic or the verification step for Family-Wise Error Rate (SC-003), violating the statistical transparency constraint.

Spec Edge Cases and SC-002 require a fallback to random-intercept-only models if convergence fails, with a 90% convergence rate metric. Task T022 is incomplete (`- [ ]`), and T022b only defines the threshold without implementing the fallback logic, failing to satisfy the robustness requirement.

FR-002 requires filtering datasets lacking sequential stimuli. Task T014 is incomplete (`- [ ]`), meaning the pipeline may process invalid data, violating the data hygiene and validity constraints defined in the spec.

Constitution Principle VI requires storing 'transition-probability tables' and 'Markov model state' as versioned artifacts. Task T017b is incomplete (`- [ ]`), creating a direct violation of the Experimental Design Documentation principle.
SC-005 requires MDE to be reported for *every* dataset analyzed. Task T025b is incomplete (`- [ ]`), meaning the sensitivity adequacy metric cannot be measured, violating the success criteria.
